questions.lbl: Known diabetes
questions.text: Does the patient have diabetes?
questions.why: Diabetes causes neuropathic and ischaemic foot ulcers and slows healing.

questions.lbl: Varicose veins / long-standing leg swelling
questions.text: Varicose veins, or long-standing leg swelling with skin darkening?
questions.why: Venous disease causes ulcers near the ankle.

questions.lbl: Calf pain on walking / cold pale foot
questions.text: Calf pain when walking that eases with rest, or a cold, pale foot?
questions.why: Arterial insufficiency causes painful ulcers on toes or heel.

questions.lbl: Numbness over the ulcer / skin patch
questions.text: Is the area numb or has lost feeling?

questions.lbl: Growing, bleeding, pearly or rolled edge on sun-exposed skin
questions.text: Is it slowly growing or bleeding, on sun-exposed skin, with a raised pearly or rolled edge?

questions.lbl: Large tense blisters in an older person
questions.text: Large, tight blisters, usually itchy, in an older person?

questions.lbl: Fragile blisters with mouth sores
questions.text: Fragile blisters that burst easily, with mouth erosions?

questions.lbl: Painful clustered blisters on one side in a band
questions.text: Painful clustered blisters in a band on one side of the body, with burning pain first?

questions.lbl: Honey-coloured crusts
questions.text: Are there blisters or sores with honey-coloured crusts?

questions.lbl: Round patches of baldness with normal skin
questions.text: Round bald patches where the skin looks normal?

questions.lbl: Diffuse shedding after illness, childbirth, stress or crash dieting
questions.text: Widespread shedding starting weeks to months after a major illness, childbirth, stress or crash diet?

questions.lbl: Scaly scalp patch with broken hairs
questions.text: A scaly scalp patch with broken hairs?

questions.lbl: Nail pitting / lifting / skin plaques elsewhere
questions.text: Tiny pits in the nails, nails lifting, or scaly plaques elsewhere?

questions.lbl: Thick, yellow, crumbly nails
questions.text: Are nails thickened, yellow and crumbly?

questions.lbl: Completely white patches
questions.text: Are the patches completely white, with no scaling?

questions.lbl: Pale patch with reduced feeling
questions.text: Is a pale or reddish patch less sensitive to touch, heat or pain?

questions.lbl: Fine scaly patches on trunk, worse in sweat/summer
questions.text: Fine scaly light or dark patches on the chest or back, worse in summer?

questions.lbl: Weak hands/feet, tingling or painful thick nerves
questions.text: Weakness of hands or feet, tingling, or tender thickened nerves?

questions.lbl: Slow-growing lump with a central dot
questions.text: A slow-growing lump with a tiny central opening?

questions.lbl: Mole changing in shape, colour or size
questions.text: Has a mole changed in shape, border, colour or size, or started to bleed?

questions.lbl: Pearly bump on the face that bleeds easily
questions.text: A pearly bump on the face that bleeds easily and does not heal?

questions.lbl: Silvery scaly plaques on elbows, knees or scalp
questions.text: Well-defined thick plaques with silvery scale on elbows, knees or scalp?

questions.lbl: Greasy scales on scalp, eyebrows or sides of nose
questions.text: Greasy yellowish scales on scalp, eyebrows or beside the nose?

questions.lbl: Blackheads and pimples on face, chest or back
questions.text: Blackheads, whiteheads and pimples on face, chest or back?

questions.lbl: Painful grouped blisters/ulcers, recurrent
questions.text: Painful grouped blisters or ulcers that have recurred?

questions.lbl: Single painless ulcer
questions.text: A single, painless, firm-edged ulcer?

questions.lbl: New partner / unprotected sex
questions.text: New sexual partner or unprotected sex recently?
questions.why: Exposure history for sexually transmitted infection.

exam.lbl: Nikolsky sign positive (skin shears with gentle rubbing)
Well-defined plaques with silvery scale (Auspitz sign)
Reduced sensation in the skin patch
Lesion with ABCDE features (asymmetry, irregular border, colour variation, diameter, evolution)

diseases.name: Psoriasis
diseases.inv: Clinical; skin biopsy if unclear. Look for arthritis.
diseases.alt: Eczema, tinea, seborrhoeic dermatitis, pityriasis rosea

diseases.name: Seborrhoeic dermatitis
diseases.inv: Clinical.

diseases.name: Pityriasis versicolor
diseases.inv: KOH microscopy of scrapings.

diseases.name: Vitiligo
diseases.inv: Clinical; Wood lamp where available; check thyroid and other autoimmune disease.

diseases.name: Leprosy (Hansen disease)
diseases.inv: Slit-skin smear, nerve examination; follow national leprosy programme guidance.

diseases.name: Acne vulgaris
diseases.inv: Clinical; consider hormonal causes if severe, in women with irregular periods or hirsutism.

diseases.name: Alopecia areata
diseases.inv: Clinical; dermoscopy where available.

diseases.name: Telogen effluvium
diseases.inv: Clinical; check ferritin, thyroid function, B12 as indicated.
diseases.alt: Androgenetic alopecia, iron deficiency, thyroid disease

diseases.name: Tinea capitis
diseases.inv: KOH microscopy and fungal culture.

diseases.name: Fungal nail infection (onychomycosis)
diseases.inv: KOH microscopy/culture before treatment.

diseases.name: Pemphigus vulgaris
diseases.inv: Urgent specialist review; skin biopsy with direct immunofluorescence.

diseases.name: Bullous pemphigoid
diseases.inv: Skin biopsy with direct immunofluorescence.

diseases.name: Herpes zoster
diseases.inv: Clinical; PCR if atypical. Facial involvement near the eye needs urgent eye review.

diseases.name: Impetigo
diseases.inv: Clinical.

diseases.name: Diabetic (neuropathic/ischaemic) foot ulcer
diseases.inv: Foot examination, blood glucose, wound swab, X-ray for osteomyelitis; vascular assessment.
diseases.alt: Venous ulcer, arterial ulcer, leprosy, pressure ulcer

diseases.name: Venous ulcer
diseases.inv: Doppler/ABPI before compression.
diseases.alt: Arterial ulcer, diabetic ulcer, skin cancer

diseases.name: Arterial ulcer
diseases.inv: ABPI, Doppler, vascular referral.
diseases.alt: Diabetic ulcer, venous ulcer, pressure ulcer

diseases.name: Skin cancer (basal cell, squamous cell, melanoma)
diseases.inv: Urgent dermatology/surgical review; dermoscopy; excision biopsy.
diseases.alt: Seborrhoeic keratosis, benign naevus, chronic ulcer, wart

diseases.name: Epidermal cyst
diseases.inv: Clinical; excision if symptomatic.

diseases.name: Genital herpes
diseases.inv: Clinical; PCR of lesion fluid; STI screen.

diseases.name: Primary syphilis
diseases.inv: VDRL/RPR and TPHA; HIV and other STI tests per national guidance.

flags.text: Ulcer in a diabetic patient with fever: exclude deep infection or osteomyelitis urgently
Changing mole: possible melanoma, urgent referral
Fragile blisters with mouth erosions: possible pemphigus, urgent review
